casiopea-constel-desc: con§tel: active reading and a collective concept map. Readers select passages (§), code them with shared concepts and synthesise their own themes.
right-constel-annotate: Create and code passages (§), and keep themes and notes in con§tel
right-constel-moderate: Moderate the shared con§tel vocabulary (rename and merge concepts, delete other readers' passages)
constel-form-public-notice: Your passages, concepts and themes are public: anyone visiting the wiki can see them, with your username.
constel-error-generic: It could not be saved. Please try again.
constellation-summary: The constellation of concepts contributed by every reader of the wiki. Concepts are linked when a reader coded them in the same passage (§); dashed, when passages by different readers overlap; dotted and faint, when they were annotated on the same page. Choose a concept to see its passages.
constellation-empty: There are no concepts yet. Select a passage on any page and press § to add the first one.
constellation-no-themes: This reader has no themes yet.
constellation-in-no-theme: No reader has grouped it in a theme yet.
constellation-group-into: Group into one of my themes
constellation-theme-empty: No concepts yet: open one on the map and group it here.
constellation-theme-delete-confirm: Delete this theme and its notes? Its concepts stay on the map.
myconstel-summary: All your passages (§), including the lost ones: those whose text changed and could no longer be located. You can export them to open in the standalone con§tel.
myconstel-needlogin: You need a registered account to have your own con§tel reading.
myconstel-empty: You have no passages yet. Select text on a page and press §.
log-description-constel: Moderation of the shared con§tel vocabulary: renamed and merged concepts, and passages (§) deleted by moderators.
constellation-merge-confirm: Merge "$1" into "$2"? Its passages and theme groupings move to "$2", and "$1" disappears.
constellation-merge-unknown: There is no concept "$1". Choose an existing one.
constel-form-gloss-placeholder: A comment or clarification on this passage
constel-pref-enabled: Use con§tel on pages: § when selecting text, passage marks and reading controls
constel-pref-enabled-help: When off, pages look as if con§tel were not installed. The constellation and your own list stay available.
constellation-graph-label-3d: Concept map in 3D: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|concept|concepts}}. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate.
